sources.title: Music ControlNet (Wu et al.)
sources.role: Discovery-bounded source used for factual verification

claims.text: The source defines Music ControlNet: pretrain a 41M convolutional UNet on mel spectrograms (512x160, ~6 s, 22.05 kHz) with genre-mood tags, then finetune a ControlNet-style adapter with per-control MLP plus zero-convolutions on extracted melody (one-hot chroma), dynamics (smoothed dB energy), rhythm (beat/downbeat probabilities), with full-drop plus random-span masking for any-subset and partial-time control; 100-step DDIM inference with CFG 4 on global style and DiffWave vocoder.

Reported numbers: in-domain extracted 6 s (all three controls): melody accuracy 58.7%, dynamics micro/macro 90.8%/64.0%, rhythm beat/downbeat F1 70.8%/40.8%; MusicCaps 10 s melody-full created 82.6% vs MusicGen 55.2% (~49% more faithful); 41M parameters vs 1.5B (35x fewer).
